coordinates.map_m: x = east, y = north, z = metres above grade (the field is 10 m below grade); origin = Century Tower
coordinates.game: X = (x - cx) * 100, Y = z * 100, Z = -(y - cy) * 100 with (cx, cy) = center_m; Y is the ray-cast collision floor (Mario's feet). Objects that hover (stars, coins) add their own offset.
coordinates.floor_m: collision floor measured by ray-casting the built level (STAND_FROM_M above the design height, straight down)

note: Anchor points for the mission author (docs/game_design.md 7.1). Re-generated on every `build_stage.py -- swamp` from the built collision. Points with a 'check' key did not measure as designed. 'actN_' keys use the design doc's act numbers; the course acts (course.lua, docs/flow.md 5) are: 1 Kickoff = design 1, 2 Stair Sprint = design 5, 3 Chomp Chorus = design 3, 4-6 coming soon (design 2 Mascot, 4 Tailgate, 6 Flyover).
